top_signals.title: Greece Annual Inflation Accelerates in August
top_signals.summary: The annual inflation rate in Greece rose to 3.8% in August 2026, up from 3.4% in the prior month. The acceleration was mainly due to higher price growth for housing and utilities, rising to 9.7% from 8.8%, and transport, which rose further to 7.7% from 7.4%.
